description: Two morphing oscillators in one voice: A can sync and frequency-modulate B through zero, and the pair can be heard mixed, ring-modulated or on their own

params.text: Sets oscillator A's frequency, four octaves below C4 to six above, C4 being 261.63Hz
Sets oscillator B's frequency, four octaves below C4 to six above, C4 being 261.63Hz
Sets how old the circuit is, from 0 to 40 years; age lifts the two high-pass corners that bend both waves, adds gain to make up the bass it loses, and widens the slow pitch drift
Sets oscillator A's level, from silence to unity
Sets oscillator B's level, from silence to unity
Morphs oscillator A's wave from sine through triangle, sawtooth and square, and then narrows the square's pulse width from a half down to a fiftieth
Morphs oscillator B's wave from sine through triangle, sawtooth and square, and then narrows the square's pulse width from a half down to a fiftieth
Steps through three sync modes on each press: off, soft, and hard, where A resets B
Sets how much of A's output is added to B's frequency, from -1 to 1; at either end B's frequency is driven through zero and runs backwards for part of each cycle

inputs.text: Sets oscillator A's pitch, an octave per volt, and sets how many polyphonic channels the whole module runs
Sets oscillator B's pitch, an octave per volt; with nothing patched here B follows oscillator A's pitch input
Adds to oscillator A's level, a tenth per volt, with the total clamped between silence and unity
Adds to oscillator B's level, a tenth per volt, with the total clamped between silence and unity
A rising edge resets oscillator A's phase, whatever the SYNC MODE button is set to
Adds to the age, ten years per volt, with the total clamped between 0 and 60 years
Adds to the cross modulation, a fifth per volt, with the total clamped between -1 and 1
Moves oscillator A's wave along the morph, one whole shape per volt, with the total clamped between -5 and 5
Moves oscillator B's wave along the morph, one whole shape per volt, with the total clamped between -5 and 5

outputs.text: The two oscillators added and halved, which is the main voice
The two oscillators multiplied together, which is the ring modulation
Oscillator A alone, after its gain
Oscillator B alone, after its gain

notes: with no output patched the module stops and only the sync lamps keep working, so nothing drifts on unheard.
the three small lamps show the sync mode: blue for off, yellow for soft and red for hard.
soft sync multiplies oscillator B by a raised cosine window tied to A's phase rather than resetting it, which thins the tone instead of cutting into it.
the pitch of each oscillator wanders on its own, driven by two slow sine waves at different rates, by at most 0.0005V for each year of age.
every discontinuity in either wave is smoothed with a polyBLEP, including the ones that sync and through-zero modulation create, so hard sync at high pitches does not alias.
the module runs at four times the sample rate below a 50kHz engine rate, twice above that and once above 100kHz.
the SHAPE, CROSS MOD, AGE and GAIN knobs each draw a gold arc from their own position round to where their CV jack has moved them.
